label: MiniMax M3.1 Flash
output:
To: @renee.whitlock
Replying to: [s01]
Cc: none
Subject: Football rundown for Monday admin meeting

Hey Renee — here's the football rundown for Monday at noon. Let me know if Dr. Pruitt wants it any other way or if she needs more from me and I'll chase it down.

GAME
We closed Friday night the right way. Vulcan Ridge 31, Brookhollow 14. Deshawn Pettaway had 3 sacks and 7 tackles, and before the coaches even met, the kids voted him defensive player of the week in the locker room. Tavion Hurst ran for 188 yards and 2 scores, including the long TD in the third quarter. On that whole drive our line pushed them 5 yards back — best I've seen them block all year. We also held them to 46 yards rushing in the second half.

PLAYOFFS
AHSAA brackets are posted. We host Clanton Valley in the first round, Friday Nov 13, 7 pm at Ridge Field, and presale tickets go on sale Tuesday. That means we have a HOME playoff game, and I'd like Dr. Pruitt to know that — the more of our people in those stands the better. Two things I need to nail down this week: gate crew and chain crew confirmed by Wednesday, and we need 6 more on concessions, sign-up sheet goes out tomorrow. If we win and have to go on the road, I'll get the bus requests to you — you said transportation needs those 5 days out, and I won't forget that one.

GRADES
Nine week grade check is in and all 52 kids on the roster are eligible. Nobody's on the ineligible list. That belongs to Tonya Greer and her study hall, Tuesday and Thursday — not to me. She's the reason our grades are clean and she's keeping it running through the playoffs. If that goes in the board report, she deserves the credit.

BOOSTERS
Boston butt sale final count is in: 208 butts sold, $6,240 raised, goal was $4,500. The money's going toward the new sideline headsets, and a big thanks to Hargrove's Meat Market for doing the smoking at cost.

Let me know if you want anything added or trimmed before this goes into the report.
